name: karaoke-queue
description: Fair queue manager for karaoke venues

scripts.build: npm run compile && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && node build/tests/queue-rules.test.js && node build/tests/debut-cadence-rules.test.js && node build/tests/round-robin-rules.test.js && node build/tests/fixed-turn-rules.test.js && node build/tests/frozen-queue-rules.test.js && node build/tests/application.test.js && node build/tests/persistence.test.js && node build/tests/round-robin-application.test.js && node build/tests/licensing.test.js && node build/tests/database-migration.test.js && node --test build/tests/ui-scale.test.js build/tests/logging.test.js build/tests/singer-suggestions.test.js build/tests/sidebar-display-name.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:drag:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/drag-electron.js
scripts.test:e2e:persistence:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/persistence-electron.js
scripts.test:e2e:round-robin:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/round-robin-electron.js
scripts.test:e2e:headless: env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:cadence:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/debut-cadence-electron.js
scripts.test:e2e:sessions:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/previous-sessions-electron.js
scripts.test:e2e:session-close:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/session-close-electron.js
scripts.test:e2e:licensing:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/licensing-electron.js
scripts.test:e2e:queue-menu:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/queue-menu-electron.js
scripts.test:e2e:diagnostics:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/diagnostics-electron.js
scripts.test:e2e:singer-autocomplete:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/singer-autocomplete-electron.js
scripts.test:e2e:sidebar-name:headless: npm run compile && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a node build/tests/sidebar-display-name-electron.js
